en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a broad grassy lawn bordered by trees and bushes. In the distance there appear to be fragments of walls or stone structures partly hidden by vegetation, suggesting ruins. On the left, a few people in early-20th‑century clothing are seated near a path. At the top, there is a printed German caption identifying the view; in the lower right there is a small imprint, likely the publisher's mark.
